conditional_predictions.rationale: If the effect is a trial-specific feature signature rather than subject/session identity, one-hot metadata alone should not predict labels under trial isolation.
A metadata/identity confound would allow subject/session identity alone to predict labels above chance.

prediction.update_rule_if_opposite: If metadata_only_balanced_accuracy is above chance by more than 0.05, identity/collection effects may contribute, and H1 must be qualified as not solely a trial-feature effect.
